About Me

An architectural designer with a passion for materiality. My work lives at the intersection of technical precision and visual storytelling — from the first concept sketch to the last finishing detail on site.

My education at Thebes Academy (2015 – 2021) equipped me with a comprehensive, practice-ready skill set: the full architectural design process, technical documentation in AutoCAD, photorealistic 3D modeling & rendering in 3ds Max, and an in-depth study of material science and finishes for interior and exterior applications.

From high-profile projects like Zamalek Club locker rooms and Sheikh Zayed villas, to public infrastructure like water stations in Al-Beheira, I bring the same obsession: the final build must be a flawless execution of the design.

Selected Projects

Banat — Luxury Jewelry Retail

Retail Design · Visualization

A sculptural gold kiosk for "Banat" jewelry in a luxury mall — shown in an exploded axonometric revealing the jewelry display towers, curved ribbon structure, and hidden storage drawers — plus an elegant boutique interior with illuminated display niches. Warm champagne tones, ribbed metal cladding and integrated lighting make every piece of jewelry the hero.

El Gendy — Luxury Jewelry Retail

Retail Design · Visualization

An elegant jewelry boutique concept for "El Gendy," built around white marble volumes and soft rose-gold accents. A refined, welcoming retail environment where warm lighting and premium materials put the jewelry collection front and center.

Smart Office Complex

Commercial Interior · 3D Visualization

A futuristic office environment designed around transparency and technology: glass-partitioned workspaces with panoramic sea views, a "Secretariat Office" with smart glass displaying live data, open-plan areas with integrated LED coves, and a boardroom where a digital business dashboard anchors the space. Sleek walnut desks, ergonomic seating and teal accent lighting create a workspace that feels a decade ahead.

Modern Rustic Home

Residential Interior · 3D Visualization

A warm, textural family home designed for slow living: a double-height living room with exposed timber ceiling, stone fireplace and geometric pendant lights; a mustard leather sofa set against rain-streaked floor-to-ceiling glass; deep navy velvet curtains framing soft daylight; and a calmer reception corner with bouclé seating and an ornate brass coffee table — rustic soul, contemporary polish.

Lakeside Villa — Night Visualization

Exterior · 3D Visualization

A contemporary glass villa perched by the water, rendered at dusk: an infinity-edge pool glowing from within, frameless glass balustrades, warm interior light spilling through full-height glazing, and landscape lighting woven through the pines — architecture that dissolves the boundary between inside and out.

Water Station Design — El Khawaja

Infrastructure · 3ds Max

Complete 3D modeling and visualization of water stations for El Khawaja: technical renderings of the pump room — vertical pumps, manifold piping and valve assemblies — alongside a bird's-eye view of the treatment hall with its overhead gantry crane. Accurate, buildable visualizations used to guide construction on a critical public infrastructure project in Al-Beheira.

Zamalek Club — Locker Rooms

Interior Finishing · On-Site Execution

Premium finishing works delivered on site for one of Egypt's most prestigious sports clubs. Curved red-and-white ceiling ribbons with integrated lighting, club-crest feature walls, and custom joinery — high-end material selection and precise implementation of the design specifications, executed to match the club's iconic identity.
